subject: English
question_text: Complete the following text with right forms of the verbs given in the box. 0.
stimulus: struggle keep purchase harm go invent build follow be borrow “Health (a) _____ wealth,” (b) _____ the proverb. We cannot (c) _____ it. We cannot (d) _____ it. We must (e) _____ our body by (f) _____ the rules of health. People (g) _____ against germs that (h) _____ the body since their birth. Medicines (i) _____ to kill germs. But, we have to (j) _____ the body fit by ourselves through the maintenance of the rules of health.
guide_solution: (a) is (b) goes (c) purchase/borrow (d) borrow/purchase (e) build (f) following (g) Struggle (h) harm (i) are invented (j) keep
